name: ms-word
description: Read, edit and create Word .docx files - including Word tracked changes, native styles and filling out templates.

docs_dir.title: Documents folder
docs_dir.description: Folder of .docx files the server may open and save. REQUIRED - the server refuses to start without it.

output_dir.title: Output folder
output_dir.description: Optional. Where msword_create writes NEW documents. Defaults to the documents folder.

kb_dir.title: Knowledge-base folder
kb_dir.description: Optional. If set, every document opened is also mirrored to Markdown here for a local RAG index.

author.title: Tracked-change author
author.description: Optional. Name stamped on Word tracked changes, e.g. your own name.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Absolute path to the python.exe that has this server's pip dependencies installed (e.g. C:\Python311\python.exe). Use plain 'python' only if the right interpreter is first on PATH - a mismatch here is the most common cause of 'dependency missing' errors.
